title: Meridian v1 generated projection
description: Shape only. Required fields are limited to the four Appendix H.5 stamp fields plus the structural keys the emitter actually writes. Prose fields are unconstrained strings: constraining `gate` or `maturity_label` to an enum would invent a vocabulary the root does not declare, which is what PH-AUTH-003's stop condition forbids. Uses same-document $defs only, because jsonschema is pinned default-features = false and cross-file $ref resolution is disabled.
